summary: Sectarian strife in Manipur since May 2023; challenge to High Court's direction for inclusion of Meitei community in Scheduled Tribes list; jurisdictional issue under Article 136; measures for law and order normalcy including security deployment, relief camps, medical care, and rehabilitation; preservation of peace at religious sites; concerns over unclaimed bodies, medical shortages, exam deferral, transportation, communication services; call for neutral unified command and restraint against provocative remarks.
final_judgment: Various directions regarding relief measures, security, medical care, communication restoration, and call for status reports; emphasis on maintaining peace and normalcy in Manipur.
